item.title: Earth's forests took 100,000 years to recover from the last climate shock — this one is moving 10 times faster
item.description: Fossilized trees from 56 million years ago reveal how long forests need to recover from extreme heat.

item.title: Treasury's recent bond and currency moves amount to 'soft-form financial repression' to cut debt costs, economist warns
item.description: An economist warns that if U.S. Treasury prices aren't allowed to fall, the exchange rate for foreign investors must adjust through a weaker dollar.

item.title: Trump panic grows as judge rules his financial records are fair game in his own BBC defamation lawsuit
item.description: Trump sued the BBC, but a court's attempt to subpoena Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner was blocked by Secret Service agents.

item.title: Reno mayor urges residents near fast-growing wildfire: your life matters more than your house
item.description: The Hawk Fire has already destroyed structures and prompted evacuations of 14,000 homes, weeks after fires north of Reno scorched 100,000 acres.
